html:
The Kurtjar, also known as the Kunggara, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the southern Cape York Peninsula, on the plains near the southeast corner of the Gulf of Carpentaria. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Their land is flat savanna crossed by rivers that flood in the wet season. Little is recorded of their life before colonisation. Neighbours on the map include the Kok Narr, the Walangama and the Gkuthaarn. Cattle stations spread across the Gulf country from the 1860s and 1870s. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
